tasks.title: Qualify visible full-shell content with current theme geometry
tasks.body:
Goal:
Qualify visible full-shell content with current theme geometry.

Current behavior:
Manual navigation screenshot review shows missing body paint despite exported Layout body markup. Full-layout captures omit the App theme provider stylesheet. The existing control-only oracle cannot reject header-covered body content. The exact hydrated offset remains a measurement question rather than an assumed provider defect.

Touch:
- `tests/Habitica.WebApp.Tests/Qualification/PageLayoutEvidence.cs`
- `tests/Habitica.WebApp.Tests/AppNavMenuTests.cs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/qualification-core.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/qualification-frame.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-navigation-journey.mjs`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui-adapters.json`
- `tests/browser-qualification/ux-ui.mjs`
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/Layout/MainLayout.razor`
- `src/Habitica.WebApp/wwwroot/css/app.css`
- `.skill-tree/documents/testing.md`
- `.skill-tree/documents/ux-ui-manifest.md`

Implementation constraints:
Render geometry variables through the current App theme provider in synthetic full-layout exports. Preserve ordinary component captures. Add an independent header-occlusion oracle and real visible body controls. Measure hydrated layout before changing header dimensions; a demonstrated sizing inconsistency may receive a scoped shared CSS correction. Preserve menu/skip/route behavior, source identity, consent and original-command fences. No deployment, live login, provider mutation or device claim. Existing navigation outcome O-9926a5e9-82a3-4d1e-9141-b03c49f26136 retains interaction evidence; missing body-visibility coverage is explicitly corrected by the required task. Required completed-contract revalidation remains source-bound.

Validation:
Use focused geometry Red/Green examples, fresh component theme captures and current Release browser journeys. Native full-shell fixtures must expose actual body markers rather than accepting empty or occluded pages.

Acceptance:
- Full-shell fixtures include geometry variables rendered by the actual App theme provider and visible primary body content.
- The oracle rejects app-bar occlusion and current shared layout keeps the main landmark and body controls below the header at normal and enlarged text.
- Current Release Chromium/WebKit shell journeys and light/dark responsive evidence pass with exact theme/build provenance and verified cleanup.

Research provenance:

- PageLayoutEvidence currently omits MudThemeProvider output; MainLayout alone does not define MudBlazor geometry variables. The current App theme source and pinned MudBlazor stylesheet own the intended dimensions.
